_comment: Single source of truth for fetched asset packs. Each source is an npm package at a pinned version with its pinned sha512 integrity (the registry's own value). A pack is a set of elements taken from a source. Licences were read at the UPSTREAM repositories (see licenceUrl), not from a mirror's claim. Nothing is fetched at run time; `npm run fetch:assets` is the only network use. See LICENSES-ASSETS.md.

sources.attribution: Keep the copyright and permission notice (ISC) with copies. A few icons derive from Feather (MIT); the same file carries that notice too. The fetch script copies it next to the files.
Keep the copyright and permission notice (MIT) with copies. The fetch script copies it next to the files.
Keep the copyright and permission notice (MIT, Microsoft Corporation) with copies. The npm package is Iconify's repackaging of the upstream SVGs; the licence text kept here is the upstream's own.

noteOnNotUsed: Open Doodles (CC0): the official source is a website download and a Figma file with no pinned, checkable archive, so it is not used.

Twemoji (CC BY 4.0), OpenMoji (CC BY-SA 4.0), Noto emoji (mixed licences across the repository): attribution or share-alike conditions, or unclear conditions, so not used. Flagged in LICENSES-ASSETS.md.
